environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (m5.large) running in a Docker container with default capabilities. Container runs with --privileged flag for legacy compatibility. Network is flat VPC with no NACLs restricting intra-VPC traffic. Service exposed directly on port 8000 with no reverse proxy. Instance has enhanced networking (ENA) with consistent low-jitter network performance (~0.05ms variance). No rate limiting configured.

config.network: flat VPC, no NACLs, direct port exposure
